name: Yuuwaku na Otoshigoro
source:
Two little girls fight over who can better please a boy.
Panties showdown, chest competition, cooking contest, bath challenge... their lustful approaches become increasingly extreme, and ultimately they start having sex in all sorts of places.
Enjoy the feeling of being contested by two different girls.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.solfa.jp/09/]official website[/url]]
